dishes.name: Spaghetti aglio, olio e peperoncino
dishes.nameEn: Spaghetti with garlic, olive oil and chili
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan as traditionally made, with no cheese.
dishes.technique: Garlic and chili are gently sizzled in plenty of olive oil, then the spaghetti is tossed in the pan with a splash of pasta water to emulsify.

sources.title: Spaghetti aglio, olio e peperoncino - Wikipedia (IT)
Spaghetti aglio, olio e peperoncino - Il Cucchiaio d'Argento

dishes.name: Pasta al pomodoro
dishes.veganApproach: Skip the grated parmigiano or use a plant-based grated cheese; the sauce itself is vegan.
dishes.technique: Tomatoes are simmered briefly with garlic-infused olive oil and basil, then the al dente spaghetti is finished in the sauce.

sources.title: Spaghetti al Pomodoro - La Cucina Italiana

dishes.name: Penne all'arrabbiata
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan; simply leave off any optional grated pecorino.
dishes.technique: Garlic and a generous amount of chili are fried in olive oil before the tomatoes are added and reduced into a fiery sauce for the penne.

dishes.name: Spaghetti alla puttanesca
dishes.nameEn: Spaghetti with tomatoes, olives and capers
dishes.veganApproach: The Neapolitan version is already vegan; omit the anchovies used in the Lazio-style version.
dishes.technique: Garlic, olives and capers are fried in olive oil, tomatoes are added and briskly reduced into a punchy sauce for the spaghetti.

dishes.name: Pasta alla Norma
dishes.nameEn: Pasta with eggplant, tomato and ricotta salata
dishes.veganApproach: Replace the grated ricotta salata with a salty plant-based ricotta or toasted almond crumble.
dishes.technique: Cubes of eggplant are fried until golden and folded into a basil tomato sauce, then topped with grated ricotta salata.

sources.title: Pasta alla Norma - Holy Cow Vegan

dishes.name: Tagliatelle al ragù
dishes.veganApproach: Build the soffritto as usual and replace the meat with soy mince or red lentils, using egg-free pasta and plant milk.
dishes.technique: A carrot, celery and onion soffritto is browned with the meat, deglazed with wine and simmered very slowly with tomato and milk.

sources.title: Ricetta del ragù alla bolognese - Camera di Commercio di Bologna
Vegan Bolognese Tagliatelle - Lazy Cat Kitchen

dishes.name: Lasagne alla bolognese
dishes.nameEn: Baked lasagna with ragù and béchamel
dishes.veganApproach: Layer egg-free sheets with a lentil or soy ragù and a béchamel made with olive oil and plant milk.
dishes.technique: Sheets of pasta are layered with slow-cooked ragù, béchamel and parmigiano, then baked until bubbling and browned.

dishes.name: Spaghetti alla carbonara
dishes.veganApproach: Swap the egg and pecorino for a silky plant-based sauce and the guanciale for smoky crisped mushrooms or tempeh.
dishes.technique: Crisped guanciale and its fat are tossed off the heat with the pasta and a beaten egg and pecorino mixture until creamy, never scrambled.

dishes.name: Cacio e pepe
dishes.nameEn: Pasta with pecorino and black pepper
dishes.veganApproach: Emulsify toasted black pepper and starchy pasta water with a cashew or nutritional yeast cream in place of pecorino.
dishes.technique: Finely grated pecorino and toasted cracked pepper are whisked with starchy pasta water into a glossy, creamy emulsion.

sources.title: Vegan Cacio e Pepe - NYT Cooking
Vegan Cacio e Pepe - Simply Recipes

dishes.name: Trenette al pesto
dishes.nameEn: Trenette with Genoese basil pesto, potatoes and green beans
dishes.veganApproach: Make the pesto without cheese, adding extra pine nuts and a little nutritional yeast for savoriness.
dishes.technique: Basil, garlic, pine nuts and cheese are pounded into pesto, then tossed with pasta cooked together with potatoes and green beans.

sources.title: Trenette al Pesto (vegan) - Six Hungry Feet

dishes.name: Fettuccine Alfredo
dishes.veganApproach: Use egg-free fettuccine and a blended cashew and garlic cream with nutritional yeast in place of butter and cheese.
dishes.technique: Fresh fettuccine are tossed vigorously with butter, parmigiano and pasta water until a smooth, creamy coating forms.

dishes.name: Ravioli ricotta e spinaci
dishes.nameEn: Ricotta and spinach ravioli with butter and sage
dishes.veganApproach: Use an egg-free semolina dough, fill with tofu or cashew ricotta and spinach, and dress with olive oil or plant butter and sage.
dishes.technique: Fresh egg pasta is rolled thin, filled with a ricotta, spinach and nutmeg mixture, sealed, boiled briefly and glazed in sage butter.

sources.title: Ravioli ricotta e spinaci burro e salvia - GialloZafferano

dishes.name: Gnocchi alla sorrentina
dishes.nameEn: Baked potato gnocchi with tomato, mozzarella and basil
dishes.veganApproach: Use egg-free potato gnocchi and a plant-based mozzarella that melts under the grill.
dishes.technique: Gnocchi are tossed in a basil tomato sauce, layered with mozzarella in terracotta dishes and baked until the cheese melts.

dishes.name: Pasta e ceci
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan when made without the anchovies of some Roman versions.
dishes.technique: Chickpeas are simmered with garlic and rosemary, partly mashed to thicken, then small pasta is cooked directly in the creamy broth.

sources.title: Chickpeas and Roman-style pasta - Turismo Roma
Rachel Roddy's pasta e ceci - The Guardian

dishes.name: Pasta e lenticchie
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan; finish with olive oil instead of grated cheese.
dishes.technique: Lentils are stewed with a soffritto and a few tomatoes, then mixed pasta is cooked in the pot until thick and creamy.

sources.title: Pasta e lenticchie alla napoletana - La Cucina Napoletana
Pasta e lenticchie alla napoletana - La Cucina Italiana

dishes.name: Orecchiette con le cime di rapa
dishes.veganApproach: Leave out the anchovies and top with crisp toasted breadcrumbs fried in olive oil and chili.
dishes.technique: The greens are boiled in the same water as the orecchiette, then tossed with oil in which garlic, chili and anchovies have melted.

sources.title: Orecchiette con le cime di rapa - PAT Puglia
Orecchiette con cime di rapa - Il Cucchiaio d'Argento

dishes.name: Pici all'aglione
dishes.nameEn: Hand-rolled pici with garlicky tomato sauce
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan: pici are an egg-free flour and water pasta and the sauce is just garlic, tomato and oil.
dishes.technique: Thick pici are rolled by hand from flour and water, then dressed with a sauce of mild aglione garlic slowly melted in oil with tomato.

dishes.name: Spaghetti alla Nerano
dishes.nameEn: Spaghetti with fried zucchini and provolone
aliases: spaghetti con le zucchine alla Nerano
dishes.veganApproach: Blend part of the fried zucchini with pasta water and olive oil to make the creamy sauce without cheese.
dishes.technique: Zucchini rounds are fried in oil, rested, then emulsified with pasta water and provolone into a creamy sauce with basil.

sources.title: Vegan Spaghetti alla Nerano - Let's Go Tomato

dishes.name: Pasta e patate
dishes.veganApproach: Rely on the starch of the potatoes for creaminess and stir in a smoked plant-based cheese instead of provola.
dishes.technique: Potatoes are stewed with a soffritto until they break down, then the pasta is cooked in the pot risotto-style and finished with melting provola.

sources.title: Pasta, patate e provola - La Cucina Italiana
Pasta e patate con provola: storia e curiosità - La Cucina Italiana

dishes.name: Pizzoccheri della Valtellina
dishes.nameEn: Buckwheat pasta with cabbage, potatoes and cheese
dishes.veganApproach: Keep the buckwheat pasta, cabbage and potatoes and replace butter and casera with garlic-sage olive oil and a melting plant cheese.
dishes.technique: Buckwheat ribbons are boiled with potatoes and cabbage, then layered with cheese and doused in sizzling garlic and sage butter.

dishes.name: Tortelli di zucca
dishes.technique: Roasted pumpkin is mashed with amaretti, mostarda and parmigiano, sealed in fresh egg pasta and served with melted butter.

dishes.name: Ciceri e tria
dishes.nameEn: Chickpeas with boiled and fried pasta
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan: an egg-free semolina pasta cooked with chickpeas and olive oil.
dishes.technique: Fresh semolina ribbons are split, part boiled with stewed chickpeas and part fried crisp in olive oil, then combined for contrast.

dishes.name: Lagane e ceci
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan: egg-free lagane with chickpeas, garlic, chili and olive oil.
dishes.technique: Hand-cut flour and water lagane are boiled and folded into soupy chickpeas finished with chili-infused olive oil.

sources.title: Lagane with chickpeas - The Pasta Project
Lagane e ceci alla calabrese - Sagr

dishes.name: Busiate al pesto trapanese
dishes.nameEn: Busiate with Trapani almond and tomato pesto
dishes.veganApproach: Simply skip the pecorino; the raw almond, tomato and basil pesto is otherwise plant-based.
dishes.technique: Raw tomatoes, almonds, basil and garlic are pounded into a fresh uncooked pesto and tossed with spiral busiate.

sources.title: Busiate with pesto trapanese - La Cucina Italiana

dishes.name: Culurgiones
dishes.nameEn: Sardinian potato and mint filled pasta
dishes.technique: A potato, pecorino and mint filling is sealed in semolina dough with a distinctive wheat-ear pleat, then boiled and served with tomato sauce.

dishes.name: Spaghetti alle vongole
dishes.veganApproach: Make the Neapolitan 'vongole fujute' version: garlic, oil, parsley and cherry tomatoes with no clams at all.
dishes.technique: Clams are steamed open in garlic oil and wine, and the spaghetti finishes cooking in their briny juices.

dishes.name: Spaghetti allo scoglio
dishes.technique: Mussels and clams are opened in garlic and wine, squid and prawns are added with cherry tomatoes, and the pasta is finished in the seafood juices.

sources.title: Spaghetti allo scoglio - Il Cucchiaio d'Argento

dishes.name: Pasta con le sarde
dishes.nameEn: Pasta with sardines and wild fennel
dishes.veganApproach: Follow the 'sarde a mare' tradition: keep the wild fennel, raisins, pine nuts and toasted breadcrumbs and leave the fish in the sea.
dishes.technique: Wild fennel is boiled in the pasta water and stewed with onion, sardines, raisins, pine nuts and saffron, then topped with toasted breadcrumbs.

sources.title: Pasta con le Sarde - Serious Eats

dishes.name: Fregola con arselle
dishes.technique: Toasted semolina fregola is cooked risotto-style in the filtered liquor of freshly opened clams with tomato and parsley.

sources.title: Fregola with clams - The Pasta Project

dishes.name: Risotto ai funghi porcini
dishes.veganApproach: Use the porcini soaking water in the stock and finish the mantecatura with olive oil or plant butter and nutritional yeast.
dishes.technique: Toasted rice is cooked by gradual additions of hot stock with sautéed porcini, then whipped off the heat with butter and cheese.

sources.title: Vegan mushroom risotto - BBC Good Food
Vegan mushroom risotto - Lazy Cat Kitchen

dishes.name: Risotto alla milanese
dishes.veganApproach: Cook the rice in vegetable stock without marrow and finish with plant butter and nutritional yeast for a golden, creamy result.
dishes.technique: Rice is toasted with onion and marrow, cooked with stock and saffron, then creamed off the heat with butter and parmigiano.

dishes.name: Risi e bisi
dishes.veganApproach: Skip the pancetta, make the stock from the pea pods and finish with olive oil and parsley instead of butter and cheese.
dishes.technique: Rice and young peas are cooked in a stock made from the pea pods until loose and soupy, almost halfway between risotto and soup.

sources.title: How to cook the perfect risi e bisi - The Guardian

dishes.name: Risotto alla zucca
dishes.veganApproach: Let the pumpkin melt into the rice for creaminess and finish with olive oil, toasted seeds and sage instead of butter and cheese.
dishes.technique: Diced pumpkin is softened with onion until it collapses, then the rice is cooked in it with stock and creamed at the end.

sources.title: Risotto alla zucca vegan - Beauty Food Blog
Risotto alla zucca - Polenta e Baccalà

dishes.name: Insalata di riso
dishes.veganApproach: Toss the rice with giardiniera, olives, tomatoes and chickpeas or marinated tofu instead of ham, tuna, egg and cheese.
dishes.technique: Rice is boiled, cooled quickly to keep it separate and mixed with diced pickles, vegetables and other cold ingredients.

sources.title: Italian Rice Salad - Recipes from Italy

dishes.name: Sartù di riso
dishes.veganApproach: Fill the rice shell with peas, mushrooms and a plant-based melting cheese and bind the rice with tomato sauce instead of egg.
dishes.technique: Rice cooked in tomato ragù lines a breadcrumbed mould, is filled with peas, cheese and small meatballs, then baked and turned out.

sources.title: Sartù di riso vegetariano - Primo Chef

dishes.name: Tiella barese
dishes.technique: Raw rice, sliced potatoes and half-shell mussels are layered in a pan with tomatoes and pecorino, then baked with water until tender.

sources.title: Teglia al forno con patate, riso e cozze - PAT Puglia

dishes.name: Risotto alla pescatora
dishes.technique: Shellfish are opened and their liquor used as stock, the rice is cooked in it and the seafood folded in at the end.

dishes.name: Minestrone
dishes.veganApproach: Simmer the vegetables and beans in water with olive oil, skip the parmigiano rind and finish with a spoon of basil pesto without cheese.
dishes.technique: Seasonal vegetables and beans are slowly simmered in a single pot, often with rice or small pasta added at the end.

dishes.name: Pasta e fagioli
dishes.veganApproach: Use the meatless version: build flavor with a soffritto, rosemary and good olive oil instead of pancetta or pork rind.
dishes.technique: Beans are stewed with soffritto and herbs, partly mashed for body, and the pasta is cooked directly in the thick soup.

dishes.name: Ribollita
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan: beans, greens and stale bread with plenty of raw olive oil on top.
dishes.technique: A thick bean and cavolo nero soup is layered with stale bread and reheated, 're-boiled', until dense enough to hold a spoon.

dishes.name: Pappa al pomodoro
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan: tomatoes, bread, garlic, basil and olive oil.
dishes.technique: Stale bread is simmered with ripe tomatoes, garlic and stock until it collapses into a thick porridge, then finished with basil and raw oil.

sources.title: Pappa al pomodoro - Eating Around Italy

dishes.name: Acquacotta
dishes.veganApproach: Leave out the poached egg and pecorino and add white beans to the vegetable broth for substance.
dishes.technique: Onions and greens are stewed in olive oil and water, then ladled over toasted bread, traditionally with an egg poached in the broth.

dishes.name: Zuppa di farro della Garfagnana
dishes.veganApproach: Make the soffritto with olive oil only, as many Garfagnana households do, and let the beans and farro carry the flavor.
dishes.technique: Borlotti beans are cooked and partly puréed, then simmered with a herby soffritto and farro until thick.

sources.title: Minestra garfagnina di farro - Il Cucchiaio d'Argento
Zuppa di farro della Garfagnana - Castiglione di Garfagnana
Zuppa di farro della Garfagnana - Piatto Tipico

dishes.name: Macco di fave
dishes.nameEn: Sicilian dried fava bean purée soup
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan: dried fava beans slowly cooked to a cream with wild fennel and olive oil.
dishes.technique: Shelled dried fava beans are simmered for a long time and stirred until they dissolve into a thick purée, often with broken spaghetti.

dishes.name: Cacciucco alla livornese
dishes.technique: Several kinds of fish and shellfish are added in stages to a spicy tomato and wine base and served over garlic-rubbed toasted bread.

dishes.name: Ciambotta
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan: a one-pot stew of summer vegetables in olive oil.
dishes.technique: Potatoes, peppers, eggplant and zucchini are added in stages to an onion and tomato base and stewed until soft and saucy.

sources.title: Italian Vegetable Stew (Ciambotta) - America's Test Kitchen

dishes.name: Fagioli all'uccelletto
dishes.nameEn: Tuscan beans with tomato and sage
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan: cannellini beans stewed in tomato with garlic and sage.
dishes.technique: Garlic and sage are fried in olive oil, tomatoes are added and the cooked cannellini are simmered in the sauce until they absorb it.

dishes.name: Parmigiana di melanzane
dishes.veganApproach: Layer the fried or baked eggplant with tomato sauce, basil and a melting plant-based mozzarella and a nut-based grated topping.
dishes.technique: Fried eggplant slices are layered with tomato sauce, basil, mozzarella and parmigiano, then baked and rested before slicing.

sources.title: Vegan Eggplant Parmesan - A Couple Cooks

dishes.name: Peperoni ripieni alla siciliana
dishes.veganApproach: Leave out the pecorino and bind the breadcrumb filling with olive oil and a little tomato sauce.
dishes.technique: Peppers are filled with seasoned breadcrumbs, capers, olives, pine nuts and cheese, drizzled with oil and baked until soft.

sources.title: Peperoni ripieni alla siciliana - Ricette di Sicilia
Peperoni ripieni di pane - Il Cuore in Pentola

dishes.name: Fave e cicoria
dishes.nameEn: Fava bean purée with wild chicory
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan: fava bean purée with boiled bitter greens and raw olive oil.
dishes.technique: Dried split fava beans are simmered and whipped into a smooth purée, served with boiled chicory and plenty of olive oil.

sources.title: Fave bianche e cicorie - PAT Puglia

dishes.name: Panzanella
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan: bread, tomatoes, onion, cucumber, basil, oil and vinegar.
dishes.technique: Stale bread is soaked in water, squeezed and crumbled, then tossed with raw tomatoes, onion and cucumber dressed with oil and vinegar.

sources.title: Classic Panzanella Salad - Recipes from Italy

dishes.name: Polenta e funghi
dishes.veganApproach: The base recipe is vegan; just skip the optional grated cheese or butter stirred into the polenta.
dishes.technique: Coarse cornmeal is whisked into boiling water and stirred slowly until thick, then topped with mushrooms sautéed in garlic and parsley.

sources.title: Funghi e polenta - A modo mio
Funghi con polenta: la ricetta tradizionale - Barracuda

dishes.name: Frittata
dishes.veganApproach: Replace the eggs with a rested chickpea flour and water batter, as in the 'farifrittata'.
dishes.technique: Vegetables are mixed into beaten eggs and cooked slowly in a pan until set, then flipped whole to brown the other side.

dishes.name: Erbazzone
dishes.nameEn: Reggio Emilia chard and parmigiano pie
dishes.veganApproach: Make the thin pastry with olive oil instead of lard and season the chard filling with garlic, spring onion and nutritional yeast.
dishes.technique: Boiled chard and spinach are sautéed with onion and lardo, mixed with parmigiano and baked between two very thin sheets of pastry.

dishes.name: Torta pasqualina
dishes.nameEn: Ligurian Easter chard and ricotta pie
dishes.veganApproach: Fill an olive oil pastry with chard and a seasoned tofu ricotta in place of the cheese and whole eggs.
dishes.technique: Chard and ricotta are layered between many thin oil pastry sheets with whole eggs nestled in the filling, then baked.

sources.title: Torta Pasqualina vegan - La Cucina Italiana

dishes.name: Pizza Margherita
dishes.veganApproach: The dough is already vegan; top with tomato, basil and a cashew or plant-based mozzarella.
dishes.technique: A long-risen dough is stretched by hand, topped with crushed tomatoes, mozzarella and basil and baked in a very hot oven.

sources.title: Vegan Margherita Pizza - Fork in the Road

dishes.name: Pizza marinara
dishes.nameEn: Neapolitan pizza with tomato, garlic and oregano
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan: tomato, garlic, oregano and olive oil, no cheese.
dishes.technique: Neapolitan dough is topped with crushed tomatoes in a spiral, sliced garlic, oregano and olive oil, then baked very hot.

dishes.name: Calzone napoletano
dishes.veganApproach: Fill the dough with tofu ricotta, a melting plant cheese and sautéed vegetables or mushrooms instead of salami and dairy.
dishes.technique: A round of pizza dough is filled with ricotta, mozzarella and salami, folded into a half-moon, sealed and baked.

dishes.name: Pesce all'acqua pazza
dishes.technique: A whole white fish is gently poached in a light broth of water, olive oil, garlic and cherry tomatoes and finished with parsley.

dishes.name: Seppie con piselli
dishes.technique: Cuttlefish strips are browned with onion and garlic, deglazed with wine and slowly stewed in tomato before the peas are added.
